channels.title: Public channels
channels.description: Public channel names, @handles, or https://t.me/channel and https://t.me/s/channel URLs. The API also accepts objects with a channel property.

maxMessagesPerChannel.title: Maximum messages per channel
maxMessagesPerChannel.description: Maximum messages collected per channel before keyword filtering. The runtime default is 50.

sinceDate.title: Earliest message date
sinceDate.description: Optional ISO date or timestamp, for example 2026-11-01 or 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z. Messages at this boundary are included. Omit to collect without a date cutoff.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Optional case-insensitive text filter. A message must contain at least one keyword. Omit or leave empty to include all collected messages.
